plugins.name: person-agent
plugins.description: A chief-of-staff butler for ZCode: the person-agent agent judges a request, dispatches labor to background subagents and reports outcomes in plain Chinese; the dispatch skill encodes when and how to hand off work; the renhua skill keeps human-facing writing readable. Port of the DSH person-agent stack.

description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 的人机管家：person-agent 子代理负责判断请求、把劳动派给后台子代理、用平实中文汇报结果；dispatch 技能规定何时派活、怎么派活；renhua 技能保证给人看的文字好读。DSH person-agent 套件的 ZCode 移植版。
